title: Korean-Style Pan-Fried Dumplings
description: A simple and delicious Korean-inspired dish featuring pan-fried dumplings. Serve as a snack or light meal.
instructions: Combine flour and water to create dough. Knead for 5 minutes.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of jjim in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over to form a half-moon shape and press edges to seal.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add dumplings to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Serve hot with a dipping sauce of your choice.
